Sofia: Quick stitch-up on INC-472 postmortem actions — can folks confirm what they're covering and the target due dates? I made a tiny table below to keep things tidy. @Devon PTAL

Devon: I'll take the 'canary rollback doc' and update the runbook. Target EOD Thu 2024-05-02. :white_check_mark:

Priya: I own the user-notification follow-up (product) — depends on QA completing the regression test. ETA Mon 2024-05-06. cc @Ethan

Ethan: QA regression is blocked on env-flaky fix in staging (ENG-INFRA ticket #823). Working with infra, aiming to unblock by Fri 2024-05-03. I'll update the ticket.

Priya: noted, will set my date to 2024-05-08 if staging is still flaky. Thanks.

Sofia: Here's a compact view:

```
Action                              | Lead    | Depends on                  | Due
------------------------------------|---------|-----------------------------|-----------
Canary rollback doc / runbook       | Devon   | none                        | 2024-05-02
User-notify regression + follow-up  | Priya   | QA regression (ENG-INFRA-823)| 2024-05-06
Staging env-flaky root-cause        | Ethan   | infra triage                | 2024-05-03
Telemetry alert tuning              | Sofia   | canary run data             | 2024-05-07
```

Devon: small ask — can we get a quick review from @Platform on the runbook changes? 15-min review window ok? :clock1:

Platform-bot: review-request posted to #eng-platform with link <https://...|runbook-diff>

Devon: thanks, I'll ping again at 11:30 PST.

Sofia: If anyone needs to shift dates, reply here with new ETA and reason. Otherwise I'll mark this as a checkpoint and carry to the postmortem follow-up doc on Friday.

Priya: ack, will update if QA slips. :thumbsup:

Ethan: updating ENG-INFRA-823 now, will comment when done. :wrench:

ops-bot: Reminder: postmortem actions checklist updated (inc-472-actions.md) — assigned items without due dates flagged.

Sofia: Closing the loop for now — next check-in Fri 12:00 PST. Thanks all.
